arms.invocation: Use $better-skill-creator to create the requested skill.

assumptions: New synthetic contract choices are preparer-selected under the authorized scope, frozen for launch review, not user statements about real accounting practice.
Both preparation routes are synthetic and share rule families but have distinct development and held-out inputs; no causal preparation-route contrast.
Two builds per arm/condition provide limited within-brief variation; dependent package uses are not independent builder observations.
One fresh baseline per case and one use per package/case prioritize coverage over execution-variance estimates.
The 600-second build deadline retains the completed pilot allowance; 90-second consumer deadlines allow more file-processing steps without making deadline pressure the intended treatment.
No retries, best-package selection, inferential estimates or general builder-ranking claim. Any further cases or attempts require a separately reviewed allocation.
A result can still reach the ceiling or floor. Report it and preserve every failure; do not adapt or extend this allocation after observing outcomes.

control_rationale.common-request: Contribution of the external builder pack compared with the same build request and pinned built-in skills; this is not an explicitly invoked official-creator comparison.
control_rationale.dovetail: Contribution of the exact external Dovetail runtime pack and explicit creator invocation under the common build and use conditions.
control_rationale.no-package: Contribution of generated-package assistance during execution when complete task facts, current input files, model and consumer deadline are shared.

facts: The user authorized autonomous preparation of more informative synthetic reconciliation work; launch is not authorized.

inferences: Interactions, policy variation and larger ledgers may expose errors hidden by the earlier single-feature tasks. This is a design hypothesis, not a measured sensitivity result.
intended_use: Descriptive condition discovery after the earlier pilot ceiling. Examine per-case failures, component errors, independent-build variation and resources before choosing any broader comparison.
request: On synthetic event-reconciliation cases with interacting rules, where do fresh consumers fail or reach a score ceiling, and how do generated-package assistance and independent builds vary under the selected conditions?
